describe: The outputs of the first run of the registered Model C comparison, on real prices, made after the registration was pushed. A repeat run on the same day reproduced every positions file and report.json byte for byte. report.md is rendered from report.json by report.py. report.md was re-rendered on the same day to show all three arms at each cost level; report.json and the positions are as first frozen.
replay_note: code_commit holds the runner and the packages. Replay from replay_checkout, which adds the registration.
open_items: The raw market inputs exist only on the machine that ran this; see the snapshot manifest.

report_renderer.note: report.md is reproduced by this version of report.py, identified by its file hash because replay_checkout holds an earlier renderer without the cost table. replay_checkout reproduces report.json and the positions; then run the command above from a checkout whose report.py has this hash.
